CA.rationale: Content (red) and an inherited/current origin are explicitly linked for the candidate referent.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red), its organization/origin metadata, and the content-vs-status separation are explicitly present for p0/current/n0.

A.rationale: Content instances are shown with inherited/current origin metadata indicating a processing/access change tied to the same referent.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (red/blue) with coordinate values are present.

D.rationale: Content coordinates and separate origin/metadata fields distinguish identity from organization/status.

O.rationale: Explicit organization/presentation metadata (origin kinds, represented_time) and display orientation statements describe how contents are presented or organized.
